assessment: The entire EHI export documentation is a 2-page PDF describing how to click export buttons in the MedPointe UI. It uses a proprietary 'C62' format with zero documentation of its structure, fields, or content. No data dictionary, no schema, no sample data. The export appears to cover only clinical documents (notes, scanned docs) — not structured clinical data (medications, labs, vitals, allergies), billing, insurance, or administrative data.
